Add a Manufacturer The customer wants to bring in item data managed in the item master of their ERP to their shopping marketplace. CORTECH manufactures many of the products the customer buys. These items are managed on the customer’s ERP. To bring these items into ePro, CORTECH needs to be added as a manufacturer in Virtual Item Master.
1. View the licenses relevant to Virtual Item Master:
• Virtual Item Master
• Contract Compliance Tracker
2. Make sure your user has the necessary permissions:
• Catalog administration
• Make sure the Catalog Admin role has the following permission: Administration > Catalog Administration > Manage Item Master
• Make sure your user has the this role.
• Contract administration
• Make sure this Contract Configuration role has the following permission: Contracts > Catalog Administrator
• Make sure your user has this role.
3. Add CORTECH as a manufacturer:

• Navigate to the manufacturers list either for item master or contract items: Contracts > Item Master Management > Add/Configure Manufacturers > manufacturers Contracts > Contracts > Contract Items >manufacturers > manufacturers

Add an Item Master Item The customer manages the list of personal care products they use to run their business in the item master of their ERP. Shoppers request these items in ePro as needed. One of these items is a toothbrush manufactured by CORTECH and offered by several suppliers Add the item master item for this toothbrush so that it is available for shopping in ePro.
1. Search for the toothbrush:

Link an Item Master It em to a Hosted Item Requirements:
• Duplicate items from the same supplier should appear only once; display the latest, clearest, and most accurate item detail inform ation in search results; and be offered at the lowest price.

• Items added to the cart should display the corresponding item master ID, commodity code, and accounting code, no matter what their source. Grainger maintains more complete, accurate information on their products in their hosted catalog than the organization does in the ERP item master, and the list price offered on the hosted catalog is the default price for this organization. The customer wants to consolidate the Grainger item master item with the hosted catalog item, showing the hosted catalog item price and detail in item search results.
1. Link the Grainger item master item to the item in the Grainger hosted catalog:
• Navigate to the edit view of item master item for the toothbrush ( 1001 ).
• View the details for Grainger.
• Show the linking details.
• View the linking rules for hosted catalog and contract items.

• Based on the linking rules for hosted cata logs, there should be multiple possible matches. Select to link the item that has the same supplier part number as the item master item by clicking the Link button. The linking icon should now display a connection between these two items.
2. Prioritize the source for item detail values and price displayed in the product search results based on customer requirements:
• Navigate to the Product Search Admin page: Shop > Shopping Settings > Configure Prod uct Search Results Settings And Filters > Product Search Admin
• Under Virtual Item Settings, make the hosted item the top priority in search results for both item detail values and price.
• Now view which item detail values are going to be displayed in search results:
• Navigate to the item master item for the toothbrush.
• Click the icon of the linked item:
• Click show source of blended data. The data that will be displayed in search results is highlighted.

Configure Automatic Linking of Items
1. Remove manual links with the item master and contract item:
• Find and unlink item master items:
• Navigate to Contracts > Item Master Management > Link Item Master Items with Contracts and Hosted Items .
• Unlink the item master link to the hosted catalog
• In the link to hosted catalog tab, in the Link Status field, select Linked - All . The toothbrush item master item linked to the hosted catalog items should appear.
• Expand linking details.
• Select Unlink .
• Unlink the item master link to the contract item
• Do the same in the link to contract tab.
• Find and unlink contract items:
• Navigate to Contracts > Contracts > Contract Items .
• In the item linking tab, in the link to hosted catalog subtab, unlink the linked item.
2. Enable the automated item linking engine and run a linking job for item master items:
• Navigate to Contracts > Item Master Management > Link Item Master Items with Contracts and Hosted Items .
• On the linking configuration/rules tab, select Enable Automated Item Linking Engine . This enables the engine for both item master and contract items.
• Note the selected linking rules.
• Save the change and run the linking job by selecting Add All items.
3. View the item linking job in the linking queue:
• Select the manage linking queue tab.
• Expand the job and view the number of links made.
4. View the links automatically made between the item master item and contract and hosted catalog items:
• Navigate to the link to hosted catalog and link to contract tabs and select the Linked - By System linked status.
5. Queue a link for contract items and run the linking job:
• View the possible matches:
• Navigate to the linking queue: Contracts > Contracts > Contract Items > link to hosted catalog
• Filter the link status on Unlinked – Possible Matches .
• Queue that link and run the linking job:
• Navigate to the linking configuration/rules tab.
• Select Save and Add All Items.
• View the item linking job in the linking queue:

Link Categories to Virtual Items The customer wants to map JAGGAER category/U NSPSC codes and organization commodity and accounting codes to items from the ERP. Link the JAGGAER category / UNSPSC and organization commodity and GL Code to the toothbrush item master item.
• JAGGAER category: Medical/Clinical
• UNSPSC : Apparel and Luggage and Personal Care Products > Personal Care Products > Dental
• Commodity code: DENTAL SUPPLIES
• GL Code: SUPPLIES - OTHER Note : Prerequisites for completing this lesson include completing the lesson from the Managing Catalogs class: Configuring Taxonomy Sets an d Custom Catalog Attributes .
1. Add the UNSPSC code and category on the toothbrush item master item:
• Navigate to the item master item for the toothbrush.
• Enter the UNSPSC code: 53131503 .
• To populate the Category field, which is the description for the UNSPSC code, select lookup category by UNSPSC and save.
2. Enable the setting to map commodity codes to the custom field value GL Code :
• Navigate to Setup > Hosted Catalog and Ordering Configuration > Category, Commodity and UOM Taxonomy Sets .
• On the Configuration tab, under the Commodity Code Field Parameters subheading, for the setting Map Commodity Codes to Custom Field Values , select GL Code .
3. Enable the linking of custom fields to a commodity code in item master items:
• Navigate to Contracts > Item Master Management > Configure Item Master Settings .
• Click the Configuration tab.
• Select the Enable Custom Field / Commodity Code Link checkbox to enable the setting.
• Select GL Code as the custom field.
4. Add GL Code values to the toothbrush item master item.
• Navigate to the toothbrush item master item. The GL Code field should now appear below the commodity code.
• Add a few GL Code values and set a default.
5. See how these codes are brought into the requisition:
• Shop for the toothbrush:
• Use the following criteria in advanced search:
• Commodity Code: SUPPLIES > HEALTH > DENTAL SUPPLIES
• Manufacturer Name: CORTECH

Link this item to the corresponding item master item using the item master ID so that it will automatically populate the correct commodity code and GL Code values on the PR.

2. Add a contract non-catalog item to the Education Lab Supplies contract:

Automatically Link Hosted Catalog It ems to Item Master Items via Item Master ID Requirement: When new item master items are brought into ePro, any hosted catalog items that have a corresponding item master ID attribute should be automatically linked to that item master item.
1. Create a new item master item for a mop bucket:
• Manufacturer name: CORTECH
• Manufacturer part number: CB5000
• Item master ID: 1002
• Description: mop bucket
• Category: bring in category name
• Commodity code: bring in from the mapped UNSPSC value
• GL Code: Select a relevant GL code or two
2. Set up a custom catalog attribute IM ID for item master IDs:
• Navigate to custom attribute administration page for item master items: Contracts > Item Master Management > Configure Item Master Settings
• Create a new attribute.
• Complete these fields:
• Attribute Internal Name: IM ID
